name: 1Zpresso Q2
details: Compact hand grinder with internal adjustment: 10 numbers per rotation, 3 clicks per number.

grindRanges.scale: rotations from zero (burrs closed); 1.8 = 1 rotation and 8 numbers

notes.turkish: 1Zpresso's Q chart lists no Turkish range.
notes.espresso: 1Zpresso's Q chart lists no espresso range.
notes.moka: 1Zpresso groups moka pot with AeroPress and drip coffee maker.
notes.aeropress: 1Zpresso groups AeroPress, moka pot and drip coffee maker.

rangeInfo.note: 1Zpresso “Q Grind Setting Reference” chart for the Q series (grind-setting_q_en_20260423.jpg on that page), in rotations: AeroPress/moka/drip coffee maker 1.2–2.0, siphon/pour over 1.8–3.2, French press 2.6–3.8.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser; Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
